title: nbn service disruption - Springdale Heights, NSW
current_summary:
The affected service in Springdale Heights, NSW 2641 was restored at about 9:11 pm AEDT on 15 October 2026, and the incident was closed at about 9:12 pm AEDT.

Restoration activities are continuing onsite. The ETR has been tentatively revised while repair works remain in progress. A revised ETR will be provided as soon as it becomes available.
